text:
morgan: Opening a docs PR to refresh the Hello Kit quickstart — mainly auth setup, deps, and a couple of link fixes. PR will include curl + SDK examples. link: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/compare
elaine: thanks — can you highlight the v6->v7 SDK migration differences? token var name changed and we should call out the auth helper usage.
samir: also add a clear minimal deploy example for first-run (one-liner curl + env var) so newbies can get a token and run quickly. keep the curl tiny.
morgan: good call. I'll keep curl to a single example and then an expanded SDK snippet. also found a stale link to /docs/local-deploy which should point to /docs/deploy/first-run.
docs-bot: deploy preview created: https://deploy-preview-482.redwood-inference.dev (status: building) :building_construction:
elaine: quick note — docker-compose example uses image tag `redwood/hello:beta`. We should pin to `0.4.2` or recommend `:latest` with note about pinning for Dedicated.
morgan: will update to `0.4.2` and add a short sentence about pinning for reproducibility in Dedicated/private installs.
samir: add a troubleshooting blur about 401s: missing KMS or wrong env var -> checklist. People hit that in onboarding.
morgan: adding a Troubleshooting section w/ checklist: 1) verify REDWOOD_API_KEY 2) confirm network ACLs 3) check local KMS env. will paste a tiny code block for export.
elaine: also update top badge — it points at staging docs. switch to production docs badge and update the sidebar link for "Quickstart" to our new anchor.
samir: small compatibility question — should we mention both `REDWOOD_API_TOKEN` and `REDWOOD_API_KEY`? some old projects still use the old var.
morgan: yes, I'll include a short migration note: "Older examples used REDWOOD_API_TOKEN; the current canonical var is REDWOOD_API_KEY; both are supported during the migration window."
deploy-bot: preview redeployed for commit abc123 (status: success) :white_check_mark:
elaine: LGTM on the content changes. Please squash WIP commits and add a PR description listing exactly what changed (links fixed, image tags, migration note, troubleshooting).
morgan: squashed and updated PR description. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/482 — requesting review from @elaine @samir
samir: reviewing now — tiny nit: in auth section prefer the verb `export` instead of `set` on Linux/mac examples. also prefer code block fenced with ```bash.
morgan: fixed wording and pushed. one more preview build incoming.
deploy-bot: preview redeployed for commit def456 (status: success) :white_check_mark:
morgan: merged to main at 3632100380 — thanks everyone :tada:
